rv.q: This production of “The Rise and Fall of Little Voice” will bring you on your feet cheering.
And, with two extraordinary performances, it is a perfect reminder of the gift that The Gift is to Chicago theatre.
The acting is generally fine, though it is difficult not to overact a character like Mari.
The second act pulls things together neatly and makes a seemingly formulaic narrative more unique and special, with a clever and entertaining ending that is not entirely expected.
